title: Project Overview & Entry Points
description: Start here to understand the project structure. The workshop-site is a Next.js event platform that handles event registration, payment processing via Stripe, email automation, and lead magnet distribution. This step covers the configuration files and main entry point.

title: Database Schema & Data Model
description: Understand the underlying database structure that powers event registrations, email tracking, lead magnets, and payment history. These migrations form the backbone of all data storage and retrieval.

title: Core Utility Libraries
description: These utility modules provide the foundation for event management, database access, and core business logic. They are used throughout API routes and components.

title: Event Discovery & Listing
description: This step shows how events are displayed to users. The events listing page retrieves available events from the database, and individual event pages render event details with registration components.

title: Event Registration Flow
description: The core user journey for event registration. This covers the registration UI component, form handling, validation, and the registration workflow that captures attendee information and manages registration state.

title: Stripe Checkout Integration
description: Payment processing system using Stripe. This includes checkout session creation, branding configuration, promo code validation, and webhook handling for payment confirmations.

title: Post-Registration: Finalization & Intake
description: After payment is confirmed, the system finalizes registration and captures attendee intake information. This includes sending confirmation emails and storing registration metadata.

title: Email System & Reminders
description: Automated email sequences for event management. Includes confirmation emails, session reminders, location reminders, and followup emails sent at scheduled times via cron jobs.

title: Event Followup Sequences
description: Post-event engagement system that sends followup emails and manages attendee lifecycle after the event concludes. Includes scheduling, deduplication, and tracking logic.

title: Abandoned Checkout Recovery
description: Email automation for users who start checkout but don't complete purchase. Includes email campaigns at scheduled intervals (e.g., 12 hours and 24 hours after abandonment) to recover lost sales.

title: Waitlist Management
description: Handles waitlist functionality for sold-out events. Users can join the waitlist and receive notifications when spots become available, with deduplication to prevent duplicate notifications.

title: Calendar Integration
description: Google Calendar integration for event attendees. Users can add events to their calendars via iCalendar format, with timezone-aware scheduling and privacy considerations.

title: Lead Magnet System
description: Lead generation through giveaways and downloadable resources. This system captures emails in exchange for valuable content, tracking signups and integrating with the email list.

title: Lead Magnet Components & UI
description: React components that power the lead magnet giveaway experiences, including email capture modals, auto-triggering popups, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

title: Email Subscription Management
description: Core email list management including subscribe, unsubscribe, and list-unsubscribe header support for compliance with email standards.

title: UTM Tracking & Attribution
description: Campaign tracking using UTM parameters to measure traffic sources and attribution. Helps understand which marketing channels drive event registrations and lead magnet signups.

title: Bonus Content & Additional Products
description: Secondary products and bonus offerings available to event participants or broader audience, including alternative checkout flows and content delivery pages.

title: Event Management & Admin Functions
description: Administrative operations for event management including registration reconciliation, event cancellation, and data maintenance.

title: Giveaway & Content Pages
description: Marketing pages for various giveaways, quizzes, and lead magnets. These pages attract users and capture emails in exchange for valuable content and tools.

title: Testing Strategy
description: Comprehensive test coverage for critical paths including checkout, email sending, registration flows, and safety guards. Tests ensure data integrity and prevent regressions.

title: Safety Guards & Compliance
description: Security and compliance safeguards built into the system. These tests and configurations ensure registration invite safety, lead magnet delivery, and prevent unintended behavior.

title: Team Access & Auth
description: Team member authentication and authorization endpoints for Illy and Jill, allowing team members to access their sections of the platform.

title: Resource Vault & Educational Content
description: Collection of educational resources and guides for users, providing additional value beyond event participation.

title: Deployment & Configuration
description: Vercel deployment configuration with domain rewrites for subdomains and scheduled cron jobs for automated tasks like email sending and event management.

title: User Journey: Complete Event Registration
description: Walk through the complete user journey from discovering an event, registering, paying, receiving confirmation, and post-event followups. This ties together all major systems.
